name: products-sold-as-singles
// command: simplest mode: run this in the project dir, in place. {port} substituted.
// build: compiled stacks: shell command producing the server binary at {out}
// exec: or: path to an existing executable or launch script to bundle
// resources: files/dirs copied into Contents/Resources (server cwd at runtime)
// port_env: env var the server reads for its listen address ('' to use args only)
// args: extra server args; {port} is substituted, e.g. ["--port", "{port}"]
// preferred_port: auto = stable port assigned from ~/.mkmacapp/ports.json; 0 = ephemeral
// health_path: empty = wait for the port to accept TCP (works everywhere)
